thesis: The episode introduces Vladimir Novikovski, founder and CEO of Lighter, a decentralized crypto exchange built as a custom layer on Ethereum using zero-knowledge circuits and a private sequencer. The discussion highlights the team's pivot from AI and fintech startups to building a platform that aims to combine the low costs and latency of centralized trading with the security, verifiability, and transparency of decentralized finance.
